title: Build parallel worktree dispatcher
summary: Build a dispatcher that selects independent roadmap tasks and prepares isolated worktree assignments within budget and artifact-scope constraints.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can safely maximize parallel roadmap execution by selecting independent tasks, preparing role worktrees, and assigning bounded workers without conflicting scopes.
acceptance: Dispatcher selects tasks by priority/order while excluding overlapping code/spec/roadmap/build/validation scopes.
Dispatcher creates role worktree plans and artifact claims for independent workers under configured budgets.
Dispatcher records deterministic dispatch evidence, pause reasons, and blocked dependency/wait states.
Workers get source-backed resume packets and do not share chat context.
Tests cover independent dispatch, overlap blocking, budget limits, stale holder avoidance, and resume packet generation.
non_goals: Do not merge worker diffs in this task.
Do not bypass validation gates or user approval requirements.

delta.desired: Roadmap execution can dispatch independent tasks in parallel safely.
delta.current: Worktree isolation and artifact claims exist, but no dispatcher maximizes independent roadmap execution.
delta.closure: Close when dispatcher logic and tests pass validation.
